newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Unilever shares rise in Amsterdam.
newsitem.headline: Unilever shares rise in Amsterdam.

text.p: Shares in Anglo-Dutch detergents to food group Unilever NV climbed 3.30 guilders to 241.80, encouraged by newspaper interviews with new UK chairman Niall Fitzgerald.
Britain's Sunday Times newspaper and the Wall Street Journal carried interviews with Fitzgerald in which he discussed streamlining Unilever's wide-ranging spread of businesses.

"People have been looking for this thing from Unilever for a long time," said Darrell Duthie, analyst at MeesPierson. "People would dearly love to see the company really focusing on what's important to it," he added. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
